messages.author: eb6e32da792b07d0
messages.subject: run the INLA computations remotely
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to run the INLA computations remotely and running R locally,as described in http://www.r-inla.org/faq#TOC-I-have-access-to-a-remote-Linux-server-is-it-possible-to-run-the-computations-remotely-and-running-R-locally-

I think I have login successfully and run the R-INLA, but I found some problems with the libraries.

Run /usr/local/lib/R/site-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla at x...@abcde.fghij.net
/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla: error while loading shared libraries: libgsl.so.0: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory

I am using Ubuntu server 16.04. 
Can anyone help me on how to overcome these? Thanks for any help.

Best regards,
-- 
Aditya

messages.author: b453c29749de564d
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] run the INLA computations remotely
parts:
Hi,

I think the problem is that you have set the variable to be

/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla

while it should be

/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.run


H
